event.title: Airlines Face Major Disruptions Following Nationwide Ground Stop
event.canonical_title: Airlines Face Major Disruptions Following Nationwide Ground Stop
event.summary: US Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy and other officials provided an update following a nationwide ground stop that lasted over four hours on Friday. The stoppage, the longest since 2001, halted all air travel across the country and stranded tens of thousands of passengers.

timeline.title: Airlines Face Major Disruptions Following Nationwide Ground Stop
timeline.summary: Airlines in the US are working to recover from a nationwide ground stop that lasted over four hours on Friday, resulting in the cancellation of more than 2,000 flights. The disruption has caused significant delays and stranded passengers, impacting travel plans across the country and internationally. Professional and college sports teams have also been affected, seeking alternative transportation options.
key_facts: Nationwide ground stop lasted over four hours on Friday.
Passengers were stranded and travel plans disrupted.
